newsitem.title: UK: Nationwide confirms holding UK lending rate.
newsitem.headline: Nationwide confirms holding UK lending rate.

text.p: Nationwide, Britain's largest mutually owned building society, said on Monday it would not follow the trend set by banks of raising mortgage rates after the recent 1/4 point rise in official UK interest rates.
"As a building society, without shareholder pressure to maximise profit, Nationwide sees no immediate justification to raise rates," the Nationwide said in a statement.

Nationwide said the decision would leave its standard mortgage rate at 0.6 percentage point below that of Halifax Plc and Abbey National Plc, which raised rates by 0.35 percentage point after the Bank of England rate rise.
